positions.commentary: The speaker decides to take a pass on Amazon because he does not know when the company will cease to exist or what its future cash flows will be.
The speaker suggests buying DuPont's spun-out company Exaltar because it is currently priced at two times earnings, which he views as a safe margin for error given that humans will eventually die.

thesis: The episode argues that an investor should avoid Amazon due to uncertainty regarding its longevity and future cash flows, while simultaneously identifying a specific opportunity in DuPont's spun-out company, Exaltar, which is viewed as a safe buy at two times earnings.
